label: App walkthrough

kinds.title: Opening card: what the tour is about.
kinds.screen: One to four real screenshots with zoom, cursor and click on what matters.
kinds.cta: Closing card: the one action viewers should take, with a button.

description: A software tour over real screenshots: title, a run of screen scenes with camera zoom, cursor, click and highlight, then a call to action. Each scene sets its pace: quick scenes cut through secondary screens, focus scenes hold on the feature that matters.

shots.fields: asset (png in project assets), focus {x,y,w,h} in image pixels or null for the full screen, cursor {x,y} optional, click true|false, highlight true|false
